name: The shed on the strip between 1834 and 1900 Prairie Avenue (district draft; refined by T-1935)

function.note: The 1911 sheet reads 'A narrow unnumbered strip between 1834 and 1900 (the block number "1" printed on it), unbuilt at the street, with a one-storey frame shed (yellow) at its alley end'. Backcast to 1904 as a yard outbuilding on the census ruling.

research_note: A DISTRICT DRAFT (T-2329, the owner's district pass of 2026-10-08): a serviceable first model, complete from the street, the walks, the alley and the air, that T-1935 refines in place under this same id. Written by tools/draft_prairie_1904.py from the sheet 28 trace (s28fp-1834_1900-b1), the T-1841 census (s28-vacant-west-1834-1900) and the T-1837 register row none; every height, roof, opening and feature is the draft rules' reconstruction (data/components/prairie_1904/draft_prairie_1904.json; liberty L-draft-prairie-18-20-west-2329).

documented_range.note: The draft claims the 1904 target and no more: the 1911 sheet draws the building and the T-1841 census rules it present in 1904 (present_as_mapped). Its building and loss dates are the per-building ticket's to read.

position.symbolic_location: 1834-1900 S. Prairie Avenue, parcel prairie_1834_1900 (data/street_grid/1904.json), west side of Prairie Avenue, Prairie Avenue, 18th to 20th Street (Sanborn 1911 vol. 3 sheet 28).
